note: Demo rule set. Values marked verified:false are from memory and MUST be checked against the official text before the pitch.

rules.source: SOLAS II-2/13 + FSS Code Ch. 13 (means of escape)
rules.text: Corridors forming part of the means of escape shall have a clear width of not less than 900 mm.

rules.source: SOLAS II-2/13 + FSS Code Ch. 13 (means of escape)
rules.text: Stairways shall have a clear width of not less than 900 mm (more depending on the number of persons).
The clear width of walking surfaces on an accessible route shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum.
Door openings on an accessible route shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.
Ramp runs shall have a running slope not steeper than 1:12.

rules.source: IGF Code (gas-fuelled ships) - simplified for demo
rules.text: LNG fuel tanks shall be separated from passenger spaces (simplified demo rule).
